properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 9 at 10:49PM EDT until September 9 at 11:30PM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
SVRRLX

The National Weather Service in Charleston West Virginia has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Perry County in southeastern Ohio...
Southwestern Morgan County in southeastern Ohio...
Northern Vinton County in southeastern Ohio...
Northwestern Athens County in southeastern Ohio...

* Until 1130 PM EDT.

* At 1049 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Logan to 13 miles southwest of Hocking Hills
State Park, moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Nelsonville, Glouster, Mcarthur, Lake Hope State Park, Chauncey,
New Straitsville, Buchtel, Jacksonville, Trimble, Zaleski, Creola,
Eagle Mills, Burr Oak State Park, and The Plains.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with these storms, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 9 at 7:47PM MST until September 9 at 8:15PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 747 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located 7 miles west of
Benson, moving southwest at 10 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Benson and Mescal.

This includes the following highways...
Route 90 between mile markers 290 and 296. Route 80 between mile
markers 293 and 298. Interstate 10 between mile markers 288 and 307.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds.

Wind damage with this storm will occur before any rain or lightning.
Do not wait for the sound of thunder before taking cover. Seek
shelter immediately inside a sturdy structure and stay away from
windows.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 9 at 7:42PM MST until September 9 at 9:45PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 742 PM MST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1
and 2 inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is already occurring
with the Baboquivari River near Tombstone exceeding bankfull.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Whetstone, Huachuca City, Fairbank and Charleston.

This includes the following highways...
Route 90 between mile markers 300 and 313. Route 80 between mile
markers 306 and 313. Route 82 between mile markers 49 and 67.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Slaughter House Wash, Middle Canyon Wash, Babocomari River,
Escalante Wash, San Pedro River, Walnut Gulch, Willow Wash and
Clifford Wash.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 9 at 11:51AM CDT until September 10 at 9:00PM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Hardin and Jefferson
Counties.

For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Pine Island Bayou near Sour Lake.

* WHEN...Until Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 25.0 feet, Water inundates roads in lowland areas near
the river. Low spots on Old Sour Lake Road are under water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:45 AM CDT Wednesday the stage was 25.8 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 22.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 10:45 AM CDT Wednesday was 26.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
tomorrow morning and continue falling to 19.9 feet Monday
morning.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 25.9
feet on 05/20/1994.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued late tonight at 100 AM CDT.

properties.description:
FFWPBZ

The National Weather Service in Pittsburgh has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Carroll County in east central Ohio...
Southern Columbiana County in east central Ohio...
Northeastern Jefferson OH County in east central Ohio...
Hancock County in northern West Virginia...

* Until midnight EDT.

* At 854 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
East Liverpool, Wellsville, Carrollton, Chester, New Cumberland,
Augusta, Salineville, Malvern, Newell, Irondale, New Manchester,
Empire, Stratton, Summitville, Mechanicstown, Hammondsville,
Glenmoor, La Croft and Tomlinson Run State Park.
